opening.label: Positive start likely
opening.headline: Positive start likely: Wall Street weak, Asia negative, crude easing
drivers: GIFT Nifty 23,119.5 (+66 pts, +0.29% vs Nifty's last close).
Asia this morning: Nikkei -2.12%, Hang Seng +1.46%, Kospi -3.48%.
Currency, crude and volatility: Brent 113.61 (-1.11%); USD/INR 94.940 (-0.28%); India VIX 15.30 (+1.21%).

story: Nifty 50 opened at 22,964, a gap-up of 0.12% from the previous close of 22,937.
The index dipped to a low of 22,905 (-0.14%) around 10:15 AM and touched a high of 23,118 (+0.79%) around 12:55 PM.
It settled at 23,053 (+0.51%), in the middle of the day's range, a session of two-way trade.
28 of the 50 Nifty stocks advanced and 21 declined; Bank Nifty lagged (-0.41%).
Latest institutional data (29 Oct): FII/FPI net -944 Cr, DII net +1924 Cr.
risks: Markets stay shut until Monday (3 days): weekend news, geopolitics and any Wall Street or Asian moves will all be priced in at the open.
Wall Street trades through tonight (from about 7:00 PM IST); the S&P 500 last closed at 7,720.39 (-0.30%), so US data and Fed commentary can swing the opening.
Brent crude is at US$113.61 (-1.11%); a sharp fall would help oil marketers and the rupee.
Currency and yields to track: USD/INR 94.940 (-0.28%), US 10-year yield 4.99% (-1.11%). A firmer dollar or higher US yields usually weigh on foreign flows.
GIFT Nifty keeps trading into the late evening, now 23,119.5 (+0.29% vs Nifty's close): the best live read on the next opening.
Nifty 50 results due on Monday: ITC.
